full_judgment: 3. The defendant Nos. 1-7 contested the suit by filing a joint written statement alleging that Sadat Ali, the predecessor-in-interest of the defendants, acquired 14.625 decimals of land in southern side of the suit land and SA Khatian No.687, RS Khatian 1388 was accordingly prepared. The contesting defendants admitted the genealogy mentioned in the plaint by the plaintiffs. The defendants also assert that by different transactions they became owners in possession of 10.5 decimals of land out of 14.625 decimals. The contesting defendants also alleged that 2nd wife of Sadat Ali and her 3 sons never possessed any portion of the suit land and the defendants are in possession of the entire 14.625 decimals of land. According to the contesting defendants, the plaintiffs could not obtain possession in execution of the decree passed in Title Suit No.40 of 1990 in Title Execution Case No.3 of 1992. The defendant denied to have dispossessed the plaintiff as alleged in the plaint.
